## Type of problem

<!-- Put an x in the box that fits best, like this: [x] -->

- [ ] **Bug:** a link, the menu, the table of contents, the theme toggle, a diagram, or another site feature is broken
- [ ] **Content issue:** something in the notes is wrong, unclear, or missing
- [ ] **Outdated content:** Microsoft Fabric or the DP-700 exam has changed since this was written
- [ ] **Device issue:** the site displays or behaves badly on a specific device or browser
- [ ] **Other issue:** something else
